# Stockfish.js source and license

This directory contains the unmodified `lite single-threaded` browser build from:

- npm package: `stockfish@18.0.8`
- Stockfish.js source: https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/tree/master
- Upstream Stockfish source: https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish
- License: GNU General Public License version 3 (`COPYING.txt` in this directory)

Distributed files:

- `stockfish-18-lite-single.js`
  - SHA-256: `5243FD9B276CAB7DFE3AD1D43AB9EAD73568FAC76468C614242977A210C4A391`
- `stockfish-18-lite-single.wasm`
  - SHA-256: `A8FBC05EC6920B56D7485826DCB02C5FFD2826BCBF751CF973046F237A9096F1`

No local modifications have been made to either engine artifact. The package
source above, its build script, and the upstream Stockfish source provide the
corresponding source and instructions used to generate the distributed binary.
